# SDK Parity

SDK Parity provides public, local tooling for SDK surface manifests,
compatibility reports, OpenAPI normalization, generated SDK artifacts, MCP
metadata, Code Mode typings, and agent-readiness evidence.

Useful public entry points:

- Quickstart: /quickstart
- SDK surface manifests: /concepts/sdk-surface-manifest
- Compatibility reports: /concepts/compatibility-diff
- OpenAPI overlays: /concepts/overlays
- MCP and Code Mode concepts: /concepts/mcp-and-code-mode
- CLI reference: /cli/install, /cli/manifest, /cli/compat, /cli/reports,
  /cli/agents
- Report schemas: /reference/report-schema

Machine-readable artifacts from `sdkparity run generate` include
`normalized-spec.json`, language SDKs, SDK manifests, snippets,
`mcp-manifest.json`, `code-mode-types.d.ts`, `agent-eval-report.json`,
`agent-readiness-report.json`, and `release-plan.json`.
